(short-lived)<br><font style="font-size:10px">/usr/bin/curl --proto =https<br>empty environment, other fds closed</font>" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="80" width="190" x="990" y="450" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="a_memfd" parent="1" style="shape=note;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;size=14;fillColor=#fff2cc;strokeColor=#d6b656;fontSize=10;" value="<b>memfd config</b> (-K /dev/fd/9)<br>url · auth header · mTLS paths<br><i>secrets never appear in argv</i>" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="80" width="190" x="990" y="570" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="a_guar" parent="1" style="shape=note;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;size=14;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#82b366;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacingLeft=8;spacingTop=4;fontSize=11;" value="<b>Design guarantees</b><br>• The journal record is written before any alert is attempted.<br>• No network code in the daemon: a forked curl child sends each alert and the daemon never waits for it.<br>• Entries whose _EXE is missing or is not a trusted sshd / sudo / su / login binary are dropped.<br>• Every journal-derived field is sanitized; JSON is escaped; chat text is sent inside code spans.<br>• SIGHUP loads the new config into a temp struct and swaps only if it is valid." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="140" width="720" x="460" y="790" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="a_ext" parent="1" div.div:
Design guarantees
• The journal record is written before any alert is attempted.
• No network code in the daemon: a forked curl child sends each alert and the daemon never waits for it.
• Entries whose _EXE is missing or is not a trusted sshd / sudo / su / login binary are dropped.
• Every journal-derived field is sanitized; JSON is escaped; chat text is sent inside code spans.
• SIGHUP loads the new config into a temp struct and swaps only if it is valid.

text.tspan: • The journal record is written before any alert is attempted.

• SIGHUP loads the new config into a temp struct and swaps only if it is valid.
